name: Gru Gun
look: A close-up of Gru from Despicable Me, the bald, long-nosed CGI villain in a gray-striped scarf and black coat, giving a calm, smug half-smile. A photo of a hand holding a silver pistol is pasted in the lower right, aimed straight at the viewer.
use: A calm, smiling threat to make someone do or stop doing something. The caption is a demand, often a petty one, like "Delete that photo" or "Say pineapple belongs on pizza again, I dare you."
slots: the demand or threat (caption above or below)
examples: Give back the hoodie you borrowed last winter
describe: gru from despicable me pointing a gun at you
